name: 70760 · New Roads, LA
findings: ZIP 70760 (New Roads) has 13 nonprofit organizations. 2 of them (15%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 2 organizations.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
